name: 'Not interested' early deflection
description: Tests Play 26 — single re-engage attempt. Must not push harder on second refusal.
callContext:
CALL TYPE: Cold call (first contact)
EXPECTED FIRST CONTACT: Unknown — probably receptionist

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Ridgeline Dental, how can I help?

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Hey, quick one. When your front desk is busy, do calls go to voicemail or keep ringing?

expectCoach.idealBehavior: Play 26 (one re-engage) ideal. Play 34 (graceful exit) also defensible on first 'not interested'.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Understood. Is it because phone coverage isn't a concern, or just bad timing?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Look, I really don't have time for this. Bye.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: Now Play 34 (graceful exit with website drop). Null also acceptable — call is effectively over. One re-engage used, now honor exit.
